title: andropogon nutans var. contractus
intro: Andropogon nutans var. contractus, commonly known as Black Needle Grass, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, contributing to its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving skin health, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Black Needle Grass are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Andropogon nutans var. contractus have been studied for their potential to promote wound healing, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit cytotoxic activity against certain cancer cells.
